collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: A villager walks along the shore while the moon lays a bright path across the lagoon.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (name1) walks along the shore while the moon lays a bright path across the lagoon. The water is so calm that the moon seems to float just beneath the surface.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (name1) walks along the shore while the moon lays a bright path across the lagoon. (name1) stops to listen to the small waves and loses track of time.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (name1) walks along the shore while the moon lays a bright path across the lagoon. A fish jumps through the bright path, and (name1) gasps aloud.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (name1) walks along the shore while the moon lays a bright path across the lagoon. (name1) walks home slowly, wishing the night would last a little longer.
